messages.subject: error when running demo2
messages.body_plain:
Hi. I've been asked to install this onto our local cluster and I've followed directions and it seems to be mostly working. However, I am having trouble with some inline documentation:

$ scons
scons: Reading SConscript files ...
scons: done reading SConscript files.
scons: Building targets ...
scons: `output/demo_r/data_trn.pdf' is up to date.
funcID(["output/demo_r/tmp/data2rdata.R/DESCRIPTION"], ["src/inlinedocs.R", "input/demo_r/src/data2rdata.R"])
cat "/gpfs20/data/sbcs/Source/maaslin/3rdParty/sfle/input/demo_r/src/data2rdata.R" | /gpfs20/data/sbcs/Source/maaslin/3rdParty/sfle/src/inlinedocs.R /gpfs20/data/sbcs/Source/maaslin/3rdParty/sfle/output/demo_r/tmp/data2rdata.R
Loading required package: methods
Loading required package: stringr
[1] FALSE
[1] FALSE
[1] FALSE
[1] FALSE
Error in FUN(src = getSource(o), name = N, objs = objs, o = o, docs = docs,  :
  argument "inlinedocs.exampleDir" is missing, with no default
Calls: main -> inlinedoc -> apply.parsers -> p -> FUN
Parser Function failed on data2rdata
Execution halted
scons: *** [output/demo_r/tmp/data2rdata.R/DESCRIPTION] Error 1
scons: building terminated because of errors.

I'm using the following versions of stuff. All except for python are brand new. Python is a few months old:

python: 2.7.6
R: 3.0.3 (some of the libraries you listed as requirements would not install in 2.x)
In addition to the R libraries you state are required, I also had to install inlinedocs and for that, I had to install stringr. All of these would be the current versions in CRAN.
sfle (current version)
maasline from repository yesterday afternoon.

Any thoughts?
